title: CarbonCreditBuy: An Open, Explainable Platform for Estimating Tree-Based Carbon Removal and Its Indicative Credit Value on Farmland
description: Open-source geospatial platform combining IPCC Tier 1 and allometric carbon estimates with ranges and provenance, Earth-observation context, region-aware programme screening (India, US, EU) and guard-railed explanation agents. Estimates are not carbon credits.
